help.main:
a2a-compat — check, convert and proxy between A2A 0.3 and 1.0 agents

Usage:
  a2a-compat check <agent-url> [--require 0.3,1.0] [--json] [--probe-send]
  a2a-compat check --mock v0.3|v1-strict|v1-compat
  a2a-compat card validate <file|url> [--json]
  a2a-compat card convert <file|url> --to 0.3|1.0|hybrid [--out <file>] [--strict] [--rewrite-url <url>]
  a2a-compat proxy --upstream <agent-url> [--listen <port>] [--infer-version]
  a2a-compat proxy --mock-upstream v0.3|v1-strict|v1-compat [--listen <port>]
  a2a-compat demo

Commands:
  check     Which client versions can talk to this agent, and why not (matrix + cause codes)
  card      Validate an agent card against both schemas, or convert it between 0.3, 1.0 and hybrid
  proxy     Run a local translating proxy in front of an agent you cannot change
  demo      Offline tour with practice mock agents: FAILS before the proxy, CAN CONNECT after

Common options:
  --json              Machine-readable output (keys are always English)
  --lang en|ko        Screen language (default: A2A_COMPAT_LANG, then LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG)
  --timeout <sec>     Network timeout (check/card: 10, proxy: 120)
  --header 'K: V'     Extra header for the agent, e.g. Authorization (repeatable, never logged)
  -h, --help          Show help
  -v, --version       Show version

Exit codes: 0 ok · 1 check failed / --strict warning · 2 usage error, missing input or unreachable agent
help.check:
a2a-compat check <agent-url> [options]

Fetches the agent card twice (no header / A2A-Version: 1.0), validates it against the 0.3 and 1.0
schemas and sends side-effect-free probes (tasks/get and GetTask for a task id that cannot exist).

Options:
  --require 0.3,1.0   Exit 1 if any of these client versions cannot connect
  --probe-send        Also send a real message/send and SendMessage (creates a task on the agent)
  --mock <kind>       Check a built-in practice mock agent instead of a URL: v0.3, v1-strict, v1-compat
  --json              Print the full report as JSON
  --timeout <sec>     Per-request timeout (default 10)
  --header 'K: V'     Extra request header (repeatable)
help.card:
a2a-compat card validate <file|url> [--json]
a2a-compat card convert <file|url> --to 0.3|1.0|hybrid [options]

validate  Detects the card version (v0.3, v1.0, hybrid, unknown) and validates it against both bundled schemas.
convert   Converts the card. Warnings go to stderr with fixed codes (LOSSY_DEVICE_CODE, ...).

Options (convert):
  --to <target>        0.3, 1.0 or hybrid (required)
  --out <file>         Write the card to a file instead of stdout
  --strict             Exit 1 if any lossy warning was produced
  --rewrite-url <url>  Point every endpoint at this URL (for a translating proxy)
help.proxy:
a2a-compat proxy --upstream <agent-url> [options]

Runs a local proxy. Clients use the proxy address as the agent address. Requests, results, SSE events,
errors and the agent card are translated between A2A 0.3 and 1.0. Features with no equivalent
(ListTasks to a 0.3 agent, push notification configs in this release) are refused with -32004.

Options:
  --upstream <url>             Agent base URL or agent card URL (fixed for the lifetime of the proxy)
  --mock-upstream <kind>       Use a built-in practice mock agent as upstream (v0.3, v1-strict, v1-compat)
  --listen <port>              Port to listen on (default 8787, 0 = any free port)
  --host <addr>                Address to bind (default 127.0.0.1)
  --public-url <url>           Address clients use to reach the proxy (written into the card; set it when binding 0.0.0.0)
  --upstream-version <v>       auto (default, read from the card), 0.3 or 1.0
  --infer-version              Accept 1.0 method names sent without the A2A-Version header
  --timeout <sec>              Wait this long for a non-streaming answer (default 120)
  --idle-timeout <sec>         Close a stream after this long without data (default 300)
  --header 'K: V'              Extra header sent upstream (repeatable, never logged)
  --log-bodies                 Also print request and response bodies
help.demo:
a2a-compat demo

Starts three practice mock agents (0.3 / strict 1.0 / 1.0 with 0.3 compatibility) on localhost,
checks each one, then puts the proxy in front of the 0.3 agent and checks again. No network or keys needed.
matrix.title: Compatibility matrix — {target}
check.vary.yes: The card changes with the A2A-Version header (Vary: A2A-Version).
check.vary.no: The card does not vary with the A2A-Version header.
check.basis: Verdicts use wire facts only (card shape, headers, error codes); client expectations follow the official JS SDK 1.3.0 / 0.3.14 default settings. JSON-RPC binding only.
cause.v03_client_cannot_parse_card: A 0.3 client fetches the card without a header and gets a card that is not a valid 0.3 card (no top-level url / protocolVersion).
fix.v03_client_cannot_parse_card: Enable 0.3 compatibility on the server (JS SDK: legacyCompat on agentCardHandler and jsonRpcHandler) or put `a2a-compat proxy` in front of it.
cause.v03_methods_rejected: The card looks like 0.3, but the server rejects the 0.3 method tasks/get (code {code}).
fix.v03_methods_rejected: Enable the 0.3 JSON-RPC dispatcher on the server, or use the proxy.
cause.v1_client_needs_legacy_compat: The agent only speaks 0.3: its card has no 1.0 supportedInterfaces and it does not know 1.0 methods. A default 1.0 client stops with 'No compatible transport found'.
fix.v1_client_needs_legacy_compat: Turn on legacyCompat in the 1.0 client (card resolver and transport), or run `a2a-compat proxy --upstream <agent>` and use the proxy address.
cause.v1_client_cannot_parse_card: The card is neither a 0.3 nor a 1.0 agent card.
fix.v1_client_cannot_parse_card: Run `a2a-compat card validate <url>` to see the schema errors.
cause.v1_methods_rejected: The card advertises 1.0, but GetTask with A2A-Version: 1.0 is rejected (code {code}).
fix.v1_methods_rejected: Check that the advertised 1.0 endpoint really runs an A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC handler.
cause.missing_version_header: Without the A2A-Version header the server treats a request as 0.3 (spec §3.6.2) and rejects GetTask with code {code}.
cause.missing_version_header.masked: Without the A2A-Version header the server treats a request as 0.3 and answers -32601 'Method not found' — the real cause (missing header) is hidden behind a method error.
fix.missing_version_header: Make the 1.0 client send 'A2A-Version: 1.0' on every request (known bug in some SDK transports), or use `a2a-compat proxy --infer-version`.
cause.no_jsonrpc_interface: The card lists no JSON-RPC endpoint for this version (REST and gRPC are not checked in this release).
fix.no_jsonrpc_interface: Add a JSONRPC interface to the card, or check the REST/gRPC binding with another tool.
cause.endpoint_unreachable: The JSON-RPC endpoint did not answer with JSON-RPC ({message}).
fix.endpoint_unreachable: Check the url in the card and that the agent is running.
fix.send_failed: Look at the agent logs; the probe message was 'a2a-compat probe'.
warning.LOSSY_DEVICE_CODE: The OAuth2 deviceCode flow exists only in A2A 1.0 and is dropped in the 0.3 card.
warning.LOSSY_MULTIPLE_SECURITY_SCHEMES: This OAuth2 scheme declares several flows; A2A 1.0 allows one flow per scheme, so only the first is kept.
warning.EMPTY_TOP_LEVEL_URL: The top-level url is empty; 0.3 clients will not know where to send requests.
warning.PROTOCOL_VERSION_PATCH: protocolVersion had a patch number (e.g. 0.3.0); 1.0 interfaces use major.minor only (0.3).
warning.HYBRID_FAILS_STRICT_V1_SCHEMA: A hybrid card keeps 0.3 top-level fields, so strict 1.0 validators reject it. Serve it only to clients that send no A2A-Version header.
warning.DROPPED_FIELD: This field has no place in the target version and was dropped.
warning.SIGNATURES_INVALIDATED: The card is signed; converting it changes the signed content, so the signatures no longer verify.
warning.NO_V03_INTERFACE: The agent advertises no 0.3 interface; this 0.3 card points at a 1.0 endpoint that 0.3 clients still cannot call (use --rewrite-url with a proxy).
warning.ASSUMES_DUAL_STACK: A hybrid card claims the endpoint speaks both 0.3 and 1.0 — true only for compat-enabled servers or behind a translating proxy.
card.validate.hint.hybrid: Hybrid card: valid for 0.3 clients, rejected by strict 1.0 validators (expected).
proxy.hint: Use {url} as the agent address in your client. Press Ctrl+C to stop.
proxy.public_warning: warning: binding to {host} exposes the proxy to other machines; it forwards your --header values upstream. The card URL stays http://127.0.0.1:<port> unless you pass --public-url.
proxy.mock_upstream: upstream is a practice mock agent ({kind}) — echo only
proxy.log.inferred: (no A2A-Version header; inferred 1.0 from the method name)
proxy.public_url: the card and the client hint advertise {url} (--public-url)

proxy.reason.batch_unsupported: JSON-RPC batch requests are not supported
proxy.reason.version_not_supported: A2A-Version '{detail}' is not supported (use 1.0, or no header for 0.3)
proxy.reason.missing_version_header: missing A2A-Version header, so the request counts as 0.3 (send A2A-Version: 1.0 or use --infer-version)
proxy.reason.v03_method_with_v1_header: {method} is a 0.3 method but the request declared A2A-Version: 1.0
proxy.reason.v1_only_method: A2A 0.3 has no method to list tasks, so {method} cannot be forwarded to a 0.3 agent
proxy.reason.not_translated: {method} is not translated in this version (push notification configs and the extended card come later)
proxy.reason.unknown_method: {method} is not a known A2A 0.3 or 1.0 method
proxy.reason.upstream_not_jsonrpc: {method}: upstream returned JSON that is not a JSON-RPC response
proxy.reason.stream_idle_timeout: {method}: stream sent nothing for {detail}s and was closed (--idle-timeout)
proxy.reason.client_closed: {method}: the client closed the connection; the upstream request was cancelled
proxy.reason.card_failed: could not read the upstream card: {detail}
proxy.reason.card_timeout: the upstream card did not arrive within {detail}s
